column3: “go to court” renders “draw near to the judgment”; NASB supplies “the judges,” and “the wicked” renders “the guilty.”
“deserves to be beaten” renders “is a son of striking”; “guilt” renders “wickedness.”
“outside the family” renders “to the outside”; “perform the duty of a husband’s brother” renders a single verb.
“assume the name” renders “stand on the name.”
“his brother’s wife” renders “his sister-in-law”; “refuses” is present for the Hebrew perfect.
“you shall not show pity” renders “your eye shall not pity.”
“differing weights” renders “a weight and a weight.”
“differing measures” renders “a measure and a measure.”
“surrounding” renders “from round about”; “the memory” renders “the remembrance.”
